lede: (stacking arithmetic in millimetres. two pieces on one body part, the listing's own measurements drawn onto the photograph, and the headline is the sum.)
idea: Every layering post on Instagram says stack them and shows a pile. Nobody says how big anything is. Naira's listings carry real millimetres — 2mm snake, 4mm paperclip, 5mm cushion, 6mm sphere, 9.5mm chevron, 12mm halo, 12mm huggie, 25mm hoop — so the set draws them onto the skin the way a technical drawing would, then adds them up. The headline is arithmetic. The basket is two pieces, priced as one stack.
type: Two figures and a plus in Velista at 150px, the plus in oxblood, a full stop after the sum because it is a sentence. Beneath it an italic Cormorant aside says what the numbers are, and a mono ledger lists each piece with its measurement, name and price; the foot totals the stack. The dimension lines are 1.5px SVG with 16px extension ticks and JetBrains Mono labels at 15px, each label carrying a half-opacity halo of the opposite tone so it survives skin, linen and sage alike.
review: Pass 1: the lines were placed from memory and missed the metal on the neck, hand and ring cards; the ear hoop rendered about a third too large for its 25mm listing; the ink top bar vanished on dark hair and, on the knuckle card, on dark skin; the story ledger wrapped. Pass 2: every line re-targeted from a five-percent grid laid over each plate in both formats (the feed and story crops differ, so each card carries two coordinate sets); the ear pair regenerated with the huggie-to-hoop ratio spelled out and shot against sage; tone flags set per card and, on the ear card, per format; label halos added; the story ledger widened.
verdict: the ear card — 12 + 25 on a sage wall — is the one to run first; it is the only stack a reader can count on their own ear.

L1.why: Two chains at two lengths: the 2mm silver snake at 40cm and the 4mm gold paperclip at 50cm. The lines mark each drop from the same collar datum, so the layering reads as a measurement rather than a mood.
L1.source: Generated for Set 04 (the neck pair, gen dc0547dd) and re-cut here below the chin.
L1.check: 2mm and 40cm on YF8439-SLV; 4mm and 50cm on YF5143; both in stock.

L2.why: The Prism Rivière's 5mm cushion stones beside the Heartbead's 6mm steel spheres — pastel against polished steel, the two textures the brand does best, each line spanning exactly one stone and one sphere.
L2.source: Generated for Set 04 (the wrist pair, gen 9db7bec6).
L2.check: 5mm on B00681C; 6mm on YF5215; both heroes at 13 units or more.

L3.why: Four fine bands of the Petite Pavé next to the Whisper Pavé's 12mm cushion halo around an 8mm stone. The tiny and the statement on one hand; the line on the left counts, the line on the right measures.
L3.source: Generated for Set 04 (the hand pair, gen ee11d7f8).
L3.check: 12mm halo and 8mm stone on WR10170K7; the band count on WR12518B read from its listing.

L4.why: The 12mm brushed huggie in the first piercing, the 25mm woven hoop in the second. Two piercings, one ear: the whole idea of a stack in a single glance, and the only card where the reader can check the arithmetic on themselves.
L4.source: Generated tonight (gen 70bcc7e3) after the first render's hoop came out a third too large; the huggie-to-hoop ratio is written into the prompt and the wall is sage for the top bar.
L4.check: 12mm across on E14776S; 25mm across on E20267O; the braid confirmed against the listing photographs.

L5.why: The Chevron Whisper's listing says it is shaped to nest against a plain band or a solitaire, so the card does exactly that: the double V sits over the Whisper Pavé's halo, 9.5mm at the chevron over a 12mm cushion.
L5.source: Generated tonight (gen 1c9bee09), two references with the knuckle as the scale referent.
L5.check: 9.5mm band height on JDR0303312-7 (5 units, listed at 3 or more); 12mm halo and 8mm stone on WR10170K7.
